Garden City is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 37 homes sold there: 25 houses and 10 townhomes. 25 houses sold in Garden City with a median price of $1,667,000 (the middle half sold between $1,480,000 and $1,965,000), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 94.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list.
Garden City home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

25 houses sold in Garden City with a median price of $1,667,000 (the middle half sold between $1,480,000 and $1,965,000), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 94.4% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $668 per square foot, a median year built of 1985 and a median lot of 4,916 square feet. 10 townhomes sold in Garden City with a median price of $1,029,000 (the middle half sold between $873,500 and $1,123,750), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 94.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $621 per square foot, a median year built of 1989 and a median strata fee of $419 a month.

items.t: Garden City Lands, 5555 No. 4 Road, lies between Westminster Highway, Alderbridge Way, Garden City Road and No. 4 Road, in the City Centre recreation area.
McLennan South allows townhouses, duplexes, triplexes and single-family lots at about 2.5 to 3 storeys, with up to 3 storeys over parking along Garden City Road.
That plan caps convenience shops along Garden City Road at 375 m2 per use.

blocks.text: Garden City: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Garden City Community Park, 6620 Garden City Road, covers 23.76 acres with an arboretum, lake, community garden, dog off-leash area and playground.
Garden City Lands has perimeter gravel paths, a community garden and a KPU farm school zone; visitors may not enter the bog.
The City's greenway plan recommends designating Saunders Road as an east-west green link to Garden City Road.
Garden City Elementary is at 8311 Garden City Road.
The McLennan South plan lists Anderson, DeBeck, Garden City and General Currie as the elementary schools its children attend; this reflects the plan's date and is not a current catchment.
Anderson Elementary is at 9460 Alberta Road.

blocks.text: Garden City: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Garden City Lands sits inside the Agricultural Land Reserve, and the City limits public access.
The ALR lies east of No. 4 Road next to McLennan South.
Richmond Fire-Rescue says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake.

faq.q: What did homes in Garden City sell for?
faq.a: From November 2025 to late October 2026, Garden City recorded 25 house sales at a median of $1,667,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Garden City?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.4% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Garden City sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 25 houses that sold in Garden City went for between $1,480,000 and $1,965,000, around a median of $1,667,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Garden City sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 25 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 94.4% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Garden City?
faq.a: The median year built was 1985 for the 25 houses sold in Garden City.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Garden City usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Garden City had 4 bedrooms, from the 25 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Richmond?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
